name: Technical Review
description: A design or code discussion: the proposal, the objections, and what was settled.

sections.heading: Proposal
sections.instruction: What was being reviewed and what it proposes to do, as the proposer described it.

sections.heading: Concerns Raised
sections.instruction: Each technical objection, with the reasoning behind it and who raised it where the transcript is clear.

sections.heading: Alternatives Considered
sections.instruction: Other approaches discussed and why each was or was not preferred. Omit if none were discussed.

sections.heading: Decisions
sections.instruction: What was settled, and explicitly what was left unsettled.

sections.heading: Action Items
sections.instruction: Work the review created, with an owner for each.
